claims.section: SEC. 2. TREATMENT OF PRESCREENING REPORT REQUESTS
claims.note: Partial tension: the bill DOES require the recipient to have 'submitted documentation to that agency certifying ... the authorization of the consumer' pursuant to paragraph (1)(A) — so a documentation step is specified. The manner of obtaining the consumer's authorization is left to existing paragraph (1)(A), so the 'how obtained' half is defensible; the 'or documented' half overstates the absence.
